code_metric.debug: Added lines in the final git patch for configured production-source files; configured test, fixture, harness, benchmark, example, and reference paths are excluded.
code_metric.rewrite: Physical lines in configured production-source files in the retained submission, treated as additions from an empty target; configured archived-evaluator tasks use their source_lines field.
code_metric.missing: Missing retained source remains missing and is never coded as zero.

response: Run-level harness success ratio; every run contributes one equal-weight fractional-logit observation regardless of harness item count.

predictor.definition: z_i = [log(1 + additions_i) - task median log(1 + additions)] / pooled within-task SD

inference: CR1 sandwich covariance clustered by task; two-sided 95% Wald intervals use t critical values with G-1 degrees of freedom.
